build_notebook_from_mdx: build a Jupyter notebook from an MDX file with framework-specific code cells for PyTorch or TensorFlow
extract_code_cells: extract Python code and output cells from MDX content using fenced code block markers
split_frameworks: read an MDX file and split content into separate PyTorch and TensorFlow versions based on framework conditionals
convert_cell_to_notebook: convert a raw code cell or code-output tuple into a proper nbformat notebook cell with outputs
create_notebooks_for_language: create Jupyter notebooks for all course sections in a given language from MDX source files
